import ctypes

# Load the GSL libraries
cblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the gsl_permutation structure
class gsl_permutation(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("size", ctypes.c_size_t),
                ("data", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t))]

# Specify argument and return types for the C functions
gsl.gsl_permutation_calloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_permutation_calloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_permutation)
gsl.gsl_permutation_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_permutation)]

def create_permutation(n):
    if n <= 0:
        return []
    p_ptr = gsl.gsl_permutation_calloc(n)
    if not p_ptr:
        return []
    p = p_ptr.contents
    result = [p.data[i] for i in range(n)]
    gsl.gsl_permutation_free(p_ptr)
    return result

def assert_test():
    # Test normal case
    assert create_permutation(3) == [0, 1, 2]
    assert create_permutation(5) == [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
    # Test edge case: n=1
    assert create_permutation(1) == [0]
    # Test error case: n=0
    assert create_permutation(0) == []
    # Test error case: negative n
    assert create_permutation(-1) == []
    print("All tests passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
